assumptions.named_model_boundary: standard Nutimo core is finite state/geometry unless the fit enables explicit harmonic soak-up on target carriers
assumptions.scope: external runtime-worthiness pilot contract; no local Nutimo build or TOA fit is performed by this script

minimal_external_artifacts.carrier_projection_rank_summary: effective rank of the three-carrier projection nuisance manifold; rank <= 5 keeps the 10.5 phase/geometric lock gate alive
minimal_external_artifacts.configuration_manifest: active parameter blocks, specialcase flag, delay flags, target carrier list, and whether RN_PL-like harmonic soak-up is disabled
minimal_external_artifacts.dynamic_chi_column: synthetic shared-tau carrier response column evaluated at Omega_in, Omega_out, and abs(Omega_in-Omega_out)
minimal_external_artifacts.finite_jacobian: residual derivative matrix for the standard fitted parameter set near the baseline solution
minimal_external_artifacts.injection_recovery_table: carrier amplitudes/phases before and after refit, with the shared G(z)=c_Y+beta/(1+tau_chi z) relation tested across all carriers

pilot_verdict: conditional runtime pilot is scientifically motivated, but only after configuration closure and before any long posterior run

rank5_but_column_absorbed.classification: effective per-carrier complex freedom or dynamic-chi column absorbed by the named nuisance span

rank5_unabsorbed.classification: finite shared projection rank with an unabsorbed dynamic-chi test column

rank6_collapse.classification: effective per-carrier complex freedom or dynamic-chi column absorbed by the named nuisance span

rows.fail_condition: local dependency repair becomes open-ended or changes the timing model configuration
rows.notes: This gate authorizes runtime only as a science test. It is not a request to reopen local build infrastructure work.
rows.pass_condition: environment can compute residuals and finite-parameter gradients without changing the scientific comparator class
rows.required_inputs: pre-provisioned Nutimo/Tempo2/Boost/Minuit environment or external collaborator runtime

rows.fail_condition: RN_PL-like per-harmonic amplitude/phase nuisance or equivalent carrier-local soak-up is enabled
rows.notes: This is the runtime version of the 10.6 source-inspection boundary.
rows.pass_condition: standard integrated three-body core is active and explicit harmonic soak-up terms are disabled for target carriers
rows.required_inputs: active par/tim configuration, delay flags, fitted parameter map, specialcase flag, and target carrier list

rows.fail_condition: carrier inventory collapses to one or two usable samples
rows.notes: Two carriers only test low-order real derivative comparators; the named pilot targets the stronger three-carrier bridge.
rows.pass_condition: three distinct positive carrier samples are present and not lost to 2:1 resonance, zero projection, or missing component
rows.required_inputs: nonzero fitted projections for Omega_in, Omega_out, abs(Omega_in-Omega_out); inner and outer periods from the named model

rows.fail_condition: effective projection rank reaches 6/6 or the dynamic-chi column is absorbed by the fitted parameter span
rows.notes: This is the decisive runtime-worthiness gate. It should be run before any posterior or long MCMC experiment.
rows.pass_condition: effective projection nuisance rank is <=5 in the six-real three-carrier amplitude space and the dynamic-chi test column is not in the fitted nuisance span
rows.required_inputs: finite residual Jacobian for standard fitted parameters and a carrier-projection extraction around the baseline fit

rows.fail_condition: standard finite parameters or admitted harmonic nuisance remove the shared-tau residual across the target carriers
rows.notes: This is a synthetic sanity pilot only. It is not a final J0337 constraint or detection claim.
rows.pass_condition: after refitting standard finite parameters, the remaining carrier relation is still best described by one shared tau_chi rather than by the admitted finite derivative comparator
rows.required_inputs: synthetic carrier perturbation generated by G(z)=c_Y+beta/(1+tau_chi z) on the three target carriers

rows.fail_condition: any earlier gate collapses or requires arbitrary per-carrier complex nuisance to describe the named fit
rows.notes: A pass promotes external runtime work to a real observable experiment; a fail closes the current dynamic-chi branch for this named implementation class.
rows.pass_condition: standard core is finite shared, rank gate is <=5, and shared tau_chi injection survives the finite nuisance refit
rows.projection_class_if_fail: named implementation no-go or conditional no-go
rows.required_inputs: configuration manifest, rank-gate result, and synthetic injection recovery table
